summary: Install-time host and system file exfiltration to Burp Collaborator endpoint
details: The gem declares an extension script in its gemspec that executes during `gem install`. On install, the script collects installer identity and local system data — current working directory, home directory, hostname, username, and the contents of /etc/resolv.conf, /etc/passwd, and /etc/hosts — and POSTs them over TLS via a raw TCPSocket to the hardcoded Burp Collaborator subdomain bjyhowqsve7p6i4fflj14mly8pel2bq0.oastify.com on port 443. The exfiltration is unrelated to the gem's stated 'simple demo' purpose and runs automatically on default install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
